```{r packages}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```
Dataset escena1
```{r}
# Cargar librerías
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# Leer el dataset
df <- read_csv("energy_dataset.csv")

# Convertir columna 'time' a tipo datetime
df <- df %>%
  mutate(time = ymd_hms(time, tz = "Europe/Madrid"))

# Crear columnas de generación total y generación renovable
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    renewable_generation = rowSums(select(., 
        `generation biomass`,
        `generation geothermal`,
        `generation hydro run-of-river and poundage`,
        `generation hydro water reservoir`,
        `generation solar`,
        `generation wind onshore`,
        `generation wind offshore`,
        `generation other renewable`
      ), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_generation = rowSums(select(., starts_with("generation")), na.rm = TRUE),
    renewable_pct = if_else(total_generation > 0,
                            renewable_generation / total_generation * 100,
                            NA_real_)  # Evita infinito
  )

# Crear resumen general
summary_df <- tibble(
  `Indicador` = c("Número total de registros", 
                  "Fecha inicial", 
                  "Fecha final", 
                  "Precio medio previsto (€)", 
                  "Precio medio real (€)", 
                  "Demanda media total (MW)", 
                  "Porcentaje medio renovable (%)"),
  `Valor` = c(
    nrow(df),
    format(min(df$time, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
    format(max(df$time, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y-%m-%d"),
    round(mean(df$`price day ahead`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    round(mean(df$`price actual`, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    round(mean(df$`total load actual`, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    round(mean(df$renewable_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1)  # Solo valores válidos
  )
)

# Guardar CSV para Flourish
write_csv(summary_df, "escena1_summary_energy_data_flourish.csv")


```
Dataset escena2
```{r}
# Leer el dataset
df <- read_csv("energy_dataset.csv")

# Convertir columna 'time' a fecha y extraer solo el día
df <- df %>%
  mutate(time = ymd_hms(time, tz = "Europe/Madrid"),
         date = as.Date(time))

# Calcular precio medio por día
daily_prices <- df %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    price_day_ahead = mean(`price day ahead`, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_actual = mean(`price actual`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Guardar CSV listo para Flourish
write_csv(daily_prices, "escena2_daily_price_comparison.csv")

```
Dataset escena3
```{r}
# Leer el dataset
df <- read_csv("energy_dataset.csv")

# Convertir columna de tiempo y extraer hora y día de la semana
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    time = ymd_hms(time, tz = "Europe/Madrid"),
    hour = hour(time),
    weekday = wday(time, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),  # Lunes, Martes, etc.
    date = as.Date(time)
  )

# Calcular generación renovable y total
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    renewable_generation = rowSums(select(., 
        `generation biomass`,
        `generation geothermal`,
        `generation hydro run-of-river and poundage`,
        `generation hydro water reservoir`,
        `generation solar`,
        `generation wind onshore`,
        `generation wind offshore`,
        `generation other renewable`
      ), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_generation = rowSums(select(., starts_with("generation")), na.rm = TRUE),
    renewable_pct = if_else(total_generation > 0,
                            renewable_generation / total_generation * 100,
                            NA_real_)
  )

# Crear dataset para Flourish (scatter plot)
scatter_data <- df %>%
  select(time, renewable_pct, `price actual`, `total load actual`, hour, weekday) %>%
  rename(
    datetime = time,
    renewable_share = renewable_pct,
    price = `price actual`,
    demand = `total load actual`
  ) %>%
  drop_na(renewable_share, price, demand, weekday)  # Filtrar filas con NA

# Guardar CSV para Flourish
write_csv(scatter_data, "escena3_renewable_vs_price_scatter.csv")

```
Dataset escena4
```{r}
# Leer el dataset
df <- read_csv("energy_dataset.csv")

# Convertir la columna de tiempo y extraer día de la semana
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    time = ymd_hms(time, tz = "Europe/Madrid"),
    weekday = wday(time, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)  # Lunes, Martes, etc.
  )

# Crear nueva columna con generación fósil agregada (suma de columnas fósiles)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    fossil = rowSums(select(., starts_with("generation fossil")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Agrupar por día de la semana y calcular media de generación por fuente
weekly_generation_sources <- df %>%
  group_by(weekday) %>%
  summarise(
    solar = mean(`generation solar`, na.rm = TRUE),
    wind = mean(`generation wind onshore`, na.rm = TRUE) + mean(`generation wind offshore`, na.rm = TRUE),
    hydro = mean(`generation hydro run-of-river and poundage`, na.rm = TRUE) +
            mean(`generation hydro water reservoir`, na.rm = TRUE),
    nuclear = mean(`generation nuclear`, na.rm = TRUE),
    biomass = mean(`generation biomass`, na.rm = TRUE),
    other_renewables = mean(`generation other renewable`, na.rm = TRUE),
    fossil = mean(fossil, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Reordenar días de la semana manualmente para asegurar orden correcto
ordered_levels <- c("lunes", "martes", "miércoles", "jueves", "viernes", "sábado", "domingo")
weekly_generation_sources$weekday <- factor(weekly_generation_sources$weekday, levels = ordered_levels)

# Guardar CSV para Flourish
write_csv(weekly_generation_sources, "escena4_weekly_generation_area_chart.csv")

```
```{r}
# Leer el dataset
df <- read_csv("energy_dataset.csv")

# Eliminar la zona horaria si la tiene y convertir la columna 'time' en fecha
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    time = str_remove(time, "\\+.*$"),     # eliminar +01:00 o similar
    time = ymd_hms(time),
    date = as.Date(time)
  )

# Calcular generación total y renovable
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    renewable = rowSums(select(., 
      `generation biomass`,
      `generation geothermal`,
      `generation hydro run-of-river and poundage`,
      `generation hydro water reservoir`,
      `generation solar`,
      `generation wind onshore`,
      `generation wind offshore`,
      `generation other renewable`
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    total_generation = rowSums(select(., starts_with("generation")), na.rm = TRUE),
    renewable_pct = if_else(total_generation > 0, renewable / total_generation * 100, NA_real_)
  )

# Agregación diaria
daily_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_price = mean(`price actual`, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_demand = mean(`total load actual`, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_renewable_pct = mean(renewable_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Identificar días extremos
top_day_renewable <- daily_summary %>% filter(avg_renewable_pct == max(avg_renewable_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(tag = "Mayor % Renovables")
low_day_renewable <- daily_summary %>% filter(avg_renewable_pct == min(avg_renewable_pct, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(tag = "Menor % Renovables")
top_day_price <- daily_summary %>% filter(avg_price == max(avg_price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(tag = "Precio más alto")
top_day_demand <- daily_summary %>% filter(avg_demand == max(avg_demand, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% mutate(tag = "Mayor Demanda")

# Unir y preparar para exportar
extremes <- bind_rows(top_day_renewable, low_day_renewable, top_day_price, top_day_demand) %>%
  select(tag, date, avg_price, avg_demand, avg_renewable_pct) %>%
  rename(
    Categoría = tag,
    Fecha = date,
    Precio_medio = avg_price,
    Demanda_media = avg_demand,
    Porcentaje_renovable = avg_renewable_pct
  )

# Guardar CSV
write_csv(extremes, "escena5_dias_extremos_energia.csv")

```
